correctedState: The real divergence is narrower and is about DEFAULTS and METADATA, not about a missing known model id. Opus 5 is fully usable on an Anthropic connection with no registry entry, because the catalogue comes from the live GET /v1/models call (drivers/anthropic.ts:17-114) and the registry only enriches it. What is actually stale: (a) a freshly created or backfilled Anthropic connection lands on Opus 4.8, not Opus 5 - DEFAULT_MODEL (models.ts:249) is claude-opus-4-8, `serverDefault` prefers it whenever the API lists it (drivers/anthropic.ts:112), ANTHROPIC_MODELS[0] feeds getDefaultModelForConnection (llm-connections.ts:718,729-734), and PI_PREFERRED_DEFAULTS puts claude-opus-4-8 first for both `anthropic` and `amazon-bedrock` (llm-connections.ts:672,683); (b) an Opus 5 the user picks gets no registry metadata, so getModelContextWindow returns undefined and the driver falls back to 200 000 tokens (drivers/anthropic.ts:104) instead of Opus 5's real window, and toBedrockNativeId passes the id through unmapped for Bedrock. Fix is a registry-currency row plus reordering the Opus entries, not an alias-resolution feature.
